saw_lines: Nobody buys a lounge chair off one ad. They compare the recline, the price and the delivery, then come back later.
So the sale is won or lost on the first screen, and no ad answers price, delivery or returns early.
Your 21 ads show no proof number, so collect one real figure, like reviews received or chairs shipped, and open new ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: None of your 21 ads shows a proof number, so a buyer scrolling past has no count to trust. Collect one real figure, like reviews received or chairs shipped, and open new ads with it on the creative itself.

Two of your 21 ads are creator posts with a code, #ad or @mention, run from the brand page. Buyers trust real owners over brand copy. Whitelist both from the creator accounts then cut new versions with the creator on camera.
None of your 21 ads mentions an offer or discount, so a first time buyer has no reason to act today. Add a first order offer or a bundle to the opening line of each new ad.

Your 21 ads open with 10 different stories, and one story leads 4 of them, so no angle gets a fair test. Pick two stories, comfort and movement, and build the next batch from them, changing only the first line.

ads_1: Comfort and movement hooks for the lounge chair, each with a first order offer
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
